help.title: About Sales
help.overview: A Sale is the unit purchase. It is either cash or a payment-plan sale. Completing a sale marks the unit sold. Approval, payment-plan installments, handover, and title-transfer are fields and actions on this sale — not separate menus. Contracts Hub only lists the same documents.

sections.title: What a sale holds
items: Unit, sold-by agent, sale currency, sale date (required; not in the future).
Payment type: cash or payment_plan (set by which create flow you used).
Final price (computed from listed price, discounts, reservation deposit conversion, exchange rates — do not treat it as a random typed KPI).
Buyer (person) and optional buyer company.
Listed unit price / currency, local discount, sale exchange rate, notes.
Purchase contract file and additional documents, transaction reference.
Optional originating reservation, plus reservation deposit amount/currency/exchange/converted amount when converting a hold into a sale.
Approval status (pending / approved / rejected) and the review notes.
Payment plan link when payment type is payment_plan (installments, interest, down payment, remaining balance).
Handover: date, who handed over, notes, certificate file.
Title transfer: date, deed number, notary name, certificate file.

sections.title: Create flows
items: Create cash sale — full amount, no installment schedule.
Create payment-plan sale — down payment, installment count, dates, optional interest; the plan is stored as its own record linked to the sale.
Either flow can start from an active reservation so the deposit converts into the price.

sections.title: Actions
items: Approve / reject — only while pending approval. Rejecting returns the unit to available and clears the sale pointer on the unit. Approving keeps the unit sold.
Pay installment / pay down payment — on the payment plan (partial payments allowed; receipts stored per installment).
Restructure payment plan — replace the unpaid schedule, keep history of the previous installments, only while the plan is active.
Manual client email — sale confirmation, or installment reminders (3-day / 1-day / today / remaining days / overdue) for a chosen installment number.
Handover and title-transfer dates are saved on edit. If the company requires a completed handover package, setting a handover date can be blocked until that package exists.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: A sold unit cannot be reserved or leased until the sale is undone through supported reject/availability paths — not by editing unit status.
Dashboard “collected” reads receipts / payment-plan activity, not a field you type on Overview.
Agent commission usually originates here (source type sale) or from the reservation that preceded it.
Payment-plan remaining balance updates as installments and down payment are marked paid.

sections.title: Related records
items: Unit (sold), buyer, optional reservation, payment plan, commissions, Contracts Hub (purchase / sale-promise views of the same sale).
